verified_facts.text: The hotel is a former 18th-century manor house set in a romantic park.
verified_facts.excerpt: This former 18th-century manor house, nestled in a romantic park, welcomes you within its walls steeped in history.

verified_facts.text: The manor house was completely restored in 1988.
verified_facts.excerpt: Completely restored in 1988, it has retained its **old-world charm**

verified_facts.text: During World War II the chateau was occupied by the Germans, and then by the Americans after the D-Day landings.
verified_facts.excerpt: It was occupied by the Germans during World War II, and then the Americans after the D-Day landings before being fully restored in 1988.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is set in a 12-hectare park that includes 2 hectares of walled gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Chenevière is nestled within a 12-hectare park, including 2 hectares of walled gardens.

verified_facts.text: The grounds have Cedars of Lebanon, ginkgo biloba trees and centuries-old sequoias alongside a collection of old roses.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cedars of Lebanon, ginkgo biloba trees, and centuries-old sequoias stand alongside a rich collection of old roses

verified_facts.text: A lime-lined avenue leads to an English garden surrounding the manor house.
verified_facts.excerpt: After strolling along the lime-lined avenue, you'll discover a magnificent English garden surrounding a former 18th-century manor house.

verified_facts.text: Each room has its own decoration combining old charm with modern comfort.
verified_facts.excerpt: The unique decoration of each of them harmoniously combines the charm of the old and modern comfort.

verified_facts.text: The rooms feature wood paneling and marble fireplaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: The wood paneling and marble fireplaces contribute to the enchantment that only old residences can offer.

verified_facts.text: The rooms are decorated in pastel tones.
verified_facts.excerpt: These pleasant rooms in pastel tones deliver

verified_facts.text: The heated outdoor swimming pool is reached by crossing the park along tree-lined paths and sits in the walled garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: To access our heated outdoor swimming pool, you will have the pleasure of crossing our park and taking one of our tree-lined paths. This picturesque route will take you to the heart of our walled garden

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is heated and open from mid-May to mid-September.
verified_facts.excerpt: The outdoor pool, open and heated from mid-May to mid-September, has a small children's pool.

verified_facts.text: The pool area is sheltered by high stone walls.
verified_facts.excerpt: the swimming pool offers privacy and tranquility sheltered by its high stone walls

verified_facts.text: Palm and citrus trees around the pool add a Mediterranean touch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our palm and citrus trees add a Mediterranean touch to the heart of Normandy.

verified_facts.text: Massages and treatments are provided in the guest's room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy moments of pure pleasure and serenity thanks to our range of tailored massages and treatments, provided in your room for maximum comfort.

verified_facts.text: Guests staying at the chateau have open access to a tennis court, and a private coach is available on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: you will discover a tennis court with open access to guests staying at the Château.

verified_facts.text: Electric bicycles are available to rent for a half day or a full day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Electric bicycles are available for rental for either half a day or a full day.

verified_facts.text: La Cheneviere has its own authorized helipad.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Chenevière has its own authorized helipad.

verified_facts.text: Helicopter tours from the helipad fly over the WWII landing beaches, Arromanches, Deauville, Honfleur, Le Havre and the Normandy Bridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is also a stopping or starting point for helicopter tours which fly over the WWII landing beaches, the beaches at Arromanches and Deauville, the town of Honfleur, the city of Le Havre, and Normandy Bridge.

verified_facts.text: The hotel can organize guided e-bike tours of the D-Day landing beaches.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel can organize guided e-bike tours of the landing beaches.

verified_facts.text: The kitchen garden is cultivated using permaculture principles and supplies herbs, fruits and vegetables to both restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: The kitchen garden at La Chenevière, cultivated using permaculture principles, supplies fresh herbs, fruits, and vegetables to the tables of both restaurants.

verified_facts.text: Honey served at the breakfast buffet comes from the chateau's own beehives.
verified_facts.excerpt: The honey served at the breakfast buffet comes directly from the château's beehives and is also available for purchase.

verified_facts.text: Every September the chateau hosts a Plant Festival with artisans and nurserymen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every year in September, Chenevière invites the best artisans and nurserymen in the country to **the Plant Festival**.

verified_facts.text: Le Botaniste, the fine-dining restaurant in the chateau, serves cuisine inspired by nature and its garden, in a room with bay windows overlooking the garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Botaniste is located in the chateau and offers fine-dining cuisine inspired by nature and its garden.

verified_facts.text: Le Petit Jardin is a bistro restaurant in the chateau's old conservatory, near the swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Petit Jardin is the bistrot restaurant located in the chateau's old conservatory, near the swimming pool at the end of the garden.

verified_facts.text: Le Botaniste's wine list covers more than 300 references, with an interest in natural and biodynamic wines.
verified_facts.excerpt: he has composed a wine list which covers more than 300 references

verified_facts.text: Bayeux is 10 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located 10 kilometers from La Chenevière, the town of Bayeux is famous for its 11th-century tapestry

verified_facts.text: The hotel can arrange transfers to and from Bayeux train station.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel can arrange for transfers to and from Bayeux Train Station.

verified_facts.text: The hotel organizes transfers from Paris Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports, Caen, Deauville and Bayeux station.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel organizes transfers from Paris (Charles de Gaulle and Orly airports), Caen, Deauville and Bayeux station.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits about 1 kilometer before the roundabout at Port-en-Bessin, at the bottom of a shaded driveway.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Chenevière is 1 kilometer before the roundabout at Port-en-Bessin on the right at the bottom of a shaded driveway

verified_facts.text: Because of Normandy weather, guests are advised to contact reception for the exact pool opening and closing dates before booking.
verified_facts.excerpt: due to the unpredictability of the Normandy weather during the seasons, it is best to contact our reception before booking

verified_facts.text: There is a small children's pool at the end of the main pool.

verified_facts.text: Golf is available at the Omaha Beach Golf Club among the activities the hotel can arrange.
